run.change_description:
Update conn state to prevent concurrent connection attempts


Make callers of resetBackoff() lock the mutex


Add doc comment for resetTransportAndUnlock


Merge remote-tracking branch 'source/master' into fix_conn_connect_race

summary.intent: Stop two concurrent addrConn.connect() calls from both seeing Idle and starting parallel connection attempts, by keeping ac.mu held from the Idle check through the Connecting transition.
summary.issue_fit: Met: issue #7365's root cause (mutex released between the Idle check and resetTransport re-locking it) is closed for both callers of the reset path; the 100000-run flake measurement could not be repeated here.
summary.coverage: Full diff of clientconn.go reviewed with callers, onClose, and the callback serializer; three concurrency premises verified; focused race-detector runs of Test/AuthorityRevive and five root-package backoff/update tests passed.

Reviewer ran `go test -race -count=1 -run 'Test/(ResetConnectBackoff|UpdateAddresses|BackoffCancel|Dial_OneBackoffPerRetryGroup|BackoffWhenNoServerPrefaceReceived)' .` at the reviewed head: 5 pass. A first run with a pattern lacking the `Test/` prefix matched no tests and is not counted as a pass.

requirements.source: pr-body/"no concurrent requests are able to start once caller of `resetTransport` does some validation and calls `resetTransport`"
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:905-924 holds ac.mu from the Idle check into resetTransportAndUnlock, which sets Connecting (clientconn.go:1261) before its first Unlock (clientconn.go:1262); premise-no-concurrent-connect holds.

requirements.source: pr-body/"caller of `resetTransport()` keep holding the mutex instead of releasing it and having `resetTransport()` re-acquire it"
requirements.evidence: Both callers, connect (clientconn.go:922) and updateAddrs (clientconn.go:996), now enter resetTransportAndUnlock with ac.mu held; premise-single-unlock and premise-handoff-no-deadlock hold.
The window between connect()'s Unlock and resetTransport's re-Lock no longer exists; state becomes Connecting under the same lock hold.

requirements.evidence: A single -race run of Test/AuthorityRevive passed at the reviewed head; the 100000-attempt measurement is not repeatable here and no supported finding depends on it.

tasks.premise: The lock hand-off in updateAddrs to the spawned resetTransportAndUnlock goroutine cannot deadlock with the deferred GracefulClose/onClose, which only waits for that goroutine's Unlock.
Both callers enter resetTransportAndUnlock holding ac.mu once, every path releases it exactly once before tryAllAddrs, and no caller unlocks again.
Once connect() has seen Idle under ac.mu, no other connect() or updateAddrs reset can start a second attempt before state is Connecting, except when ac.ctx is cancelled and no attempt is made.
